name: Colo-i-Suva Forest Reserve
story: Colo-i-Suva Forest Reserve is a nature reserve near Suva in Fiji. Established in 1872, it covers two and a half square kilometres of verdant rainforests renowned for tropical flora and birds. The Waisila Creek flows through the park.
matters: The forest is part of the Queen's Commonwealth Canopy and serves as the water catchment for Nausori and Nasinu creek.
